# Community code of conduct

PDF Editor Offline welcomes users and contributors of every background and experience level.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, specific, and patient.
- Critique code and decisions, not people.
- Protect privacy: never publish another person's document, personal data, credentials, or private correspondence.
- Assume good intent while still naming security, accessibility, and correctness problems clearly.
- Help keep discussions searchable and on topic.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized attention, doxxing, deliberate disruption, spam, and publishing confidential data are not acceptable in project spaces.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner through the contact route on the maintainer's GitHub profile. Reports will be reviewed confidentially. Maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, reject contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation when needed to protect the community.

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, discussions, release threads, and project events.
